parameters.name: AccessControlStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the whitelist. Valid values:

*   **open_white_list**: enables the whitelist.
*   **close**: disables the whitelist.

>  After the whitelist is enabled, if no IP address is added to the whitelist, the CLB instance does not distribute network traffic.

parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

parameters.name: ListenerProtocol
parameters.description:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

>  This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the CLB instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb set-listener-access-control-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-8vb86hxixo8lvsja80000 --listener-port 80 --access-control-status open_white_list --listener-protocol https --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun slb SetListenerAccessControlStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ListenerPort 80 --AccessControlStatus open_white_list --LoadBalancerId 'lb-8vb86hxixo8lvsja80000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ListenerProtocol https
